verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages cover O-1 (eligibility checker, criteria-mapped evidence), H-1B (startup sponsorship guide, transfers and extensions), TN (category fit assessment), and the EB-1A and EB-2 NIW green-card paths. It also claims to help startups identify the right visa or green-card path and to assess category fit before preparation begins. However, the evidence contains nothing on E-2 and nothing on cap-exempt H-1B routes, and the 'choosing' guidance is only asserted at a high level. Missing for 10: E-2 coverage, H-1B cap-exempt routes, concrete comparative guidance on choosing between visas, other green-card paths beyond EB-1A/NIW, independent corroboration.
